_doc: Golden of the PowerShell fixture (one real pwsh parse per file, link + reach, closed world). Roots: the manual marker of run.ps1 and a soft test root on tests/Used.Tests.ps1 (what roots.py adds for *.Tests.ps1). dead = verdict dead or dead-cluster. alive = reached only through a computed form: a dot-source of (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'lib/init.ps1') (an include of the literal), & "Dyn-$n" (a dyn site name:dyn-*), ${function:Fvar-Target} (a ref). Widget is reached only through `New-Object Widget` (a plain-name argument) and its constructor with it, Plainfn only through `Get-Command Plainfn`.
